statement: Kimberly Guilfoyle resigns or is removed as US Ambassador to Greece, with the departure announced by her, the White House or the State Department between 2026-10-13 and 2026-10-27.
resolution: A White House, State Department or Guilfoyle statement, or reports from at least two of AP, Reuters and BBC, confirm her resignation or removal as US Ambassador to Greece announced between 2026-10-13 and 2026-10-27.
failure_condition: No resignation or removal of Kimberly Guilfoyle as US Ambassador to Greece takes place or is announced between 2026-10-13 and 2026-10-27.
